root.description: Directory below the gateway's static root.

expected_active_hash.description:
Current active content hash required by compare-and-swap. Omit or use
null only for the first activation, when no configuration is active.

ActiveHealthCheck.description: Probes every endpoint; thresholds count consecutive results.

expected_statuses.description: Statuses meaning healthy; empty means any 2xx or 3xx.

host.description: `Host` sent with HTTP probes; the endpoint address otherwise.

expected_version.description: Refuses to apply if the draft changed since this version.

BatchAction.description: One item of a batch change; the batch applies only if every item can.

redirect.description: Redirects to the primary domain instead of serving the site.

DomainCheck.description: Syntax, normalization and ownership of a host an operator typed.

error.description: Why the input is not a valid host name.

host.description: The canonical ASCII form, when the input is valid.

oneOf.description: The site already serving this host, if any.

DomainView.description: A domain with the site it belongs to.

pending.description: Whether the draft has changes the gateway does not run.

Listener.description: A fixed listening socket shared by the sites it serves.

default_site_id.description: Serves requests for unknown hosts; they are rejected with 421 otherwise.

tls_profile_id.description: Serves HTTPS with this profile's certificate when no domain claims one.

ListenerProtocols.description:
HTTP versions accepted on a listener. With TLS, HTTP/2 is negotiated with
ALPN; without TLS it is accepted with prior knowledge (h2c).

MatchKind.description:
Explicit matcher kinds; there is no implicit precedence between them
beyond the documented tie-break for equal priorities.

id.description: Keeps an existing node's identity when a whole upstream is replaced.

NormalizedHost.description:
A DNS host name in canonical A-label form, or a wildcard pattern whose
leftmost label is `*` (RFC 6125 §6.4.3 without partial-label wildcards).

PassiveHealthPolicy.description: Ejects an endpoint after consecutive proxy failures for `ejection_ms`.

ProtocolSupportResponse.description: The revisions of one protocol package an instance speaks.

id.description: Keeps an existing route's identity when a whole site is replaced.

oneOf.description: Restricts a prefix route to one of the site's hosts.

path.description: An absolute path, glob or regular expression, depending on `kind`.

order.description: Every route of the site, first to last.

started_at.description: RFC 3339 start time of the instance.

ServiceListingResponse.description: Live service instances at one moment.

observed_at.description: RFC 3339 time at which the directory was read.

action.description: What the site does for requests no route claims; also its type.

deleted_at.description: Set while the site is in the recycle bin.

listener_ids.description: Listeners serving the site; empty means all of them.

routes.description: Evaluated by priority before the site action.

tls_profile_id.description: Certificate for domains that do not name their own.

SiteBundle.description: Sites with the upstreams and TLS profiles they reference, for export.

SiteInput.description: A site as clients write it; identity and timestamps are server-managed.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page.

https.description: Whether an HTTPS listener serves the site.

unicode_hosts.description: Unicode forms of internationalized domains, keyed by their ASCII form.

SiteView.description: A site with the state derived from the rest of the configuration.

schema_version.description: Selects the compiler/schema reader before the document is interpreted.

snapshot.description: Versioned source document interpreted by the injected ConfigCompiler.

UpstreamConnectionPolicy.description: Timeouts are in milliseconds; `None` uses the engine default.

http2.description: Speaks HTTP/2 to TLS upstreams that negotiate it with ALPN.

idle_timeout_ms.description: How long an idle pooled connection is kept.

keepalive.description: Reuses upstream connections from the pool.

max_connections.description: Concurrent requests per endpoint; saturated endpoints are skipped.

backup.description: Serves only while no primary node is available.

host.description: IP literal or DNS name, resolved when a configuration is applied.

ca_secret_id.description: Trust anchors replacing the system roots, as a PEM bundle secret.

sni.description: Server name for endpoints that do not set their own.

used_by.description: Live sites that send traffic here.

ValidationResult.description: Diagnostics of the whole draft or of the requested sites.

tags.name: configuration
tags.description: Sites, domains, routes, upstreams, listeners and TLS profiles, edited as a draft and applied to the gateway
